extracted.name: Salty Chihuahua
extracted.description: A Salty Chihuahua is a tequila-lemonade cocktail that's a variation on the Salty Dog. It's made in a salt-rimmed glass, and it's fun to say.
instruction_lines: Wet the rim of an old-fashioned glass with lime juice, then dip in salt. Fill glass with ice. Pour in tequila and lemonade. Squeeze and drop in the lime wedge. Stir.
